definitions.explanation: A person's physical appearance, particularly their facial features. A formal, literary word for how someone looks.

examples.japanese: {容貌|ようぼう}が{母親|ははおや}に{似|に}ている。
{年齢|ねんれい}とともに{容貌|ようぼう}も{変|か}わっていく。
{彼|かれ}は{端正|たんせい}な{容貌|ようぼう}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}で、{誰|だれ}からも{好|す}かれた。
examples.english: He had refined features and was liked by everyone.

notes: A formal, literary word for a person's physical appearance, especially the face. More elevated in register than {顔|かお} (face) or {外見|がいけん} (outward appearance). Common collocations: {容貌|ようぼう}{端麗|たんれい} (beautiful appearance), {端正|たんせい}な{容貌|ようぼう} (refined features). Homophone: {要望|ようぼう} (request, demand) — different kanji and meaning.
